title: Seagrove Beach "Wine'd Down" 498 Eastern Lake Rd
h1: Seagrove Beach "Wine'd Down" 498 Eastern Lake Rd
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Steps to the Beach!! - Gulf & lake views- Gas grill- 7 adult bikes- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Raise a glass to relaxation at Wine’d Down! This aptly named Seagrove Beach home pairs refined luxury with easy beach access for an unforgettable Emerald Coast vacation. Sleeping up to 18 guests and boasting 7 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, 2 kitchens, and 2 living spaces, there’s plenty of space for large groups or multiple families. Imagine cheerful mornings taking in the view of Eastern Lake before heading to the shimmering Gulf—the boardwalk is steps away!The first level of this beautiful 3-story home is designed for unwinding. Kids and teenagers will love co-opting the living area’s comfy sectional and TV. Nearby, a high-top table and built-in peninsula each seat 4 for snacks or card games, and there’s even a full kitchen! Outside, stretch out on the cushioned loungers and enjoy the shady porch. There are 2 guest bedrooms, each with a queen bed, as well as 1 bunk room with a queen-over-queen bed.Venture upstairs to find a spacious great room, filled with natural light and boasting an open layout for effortless mingling. Natural wood, shiplap walls, and views of the turquoise Gulf add peaceful beach vibes throughout. After a day of coastal fun, settle into the soft sectional for a movie night. The gourmet kitchen features quartz countertops, a French-door refrigerator, and a 4-stool breakfast bar, where guests can entertain while crafting culinary delights to share at the round 6-person table. The wraparound porch, furnished with comfortable seating, is the perfect spot to wind down the night with a cocktail while enjoying views of Eastern Lake and the Gulf. Sleeping accommodations on this floor include a guest bedroom with a queen bed and a bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds. A full-size washer and dryer in the communal bathroom add convenience to extended stays.Rest in luxury in the 2 primary bedrooms with king beds and private bathrooms on the top floor. Both bedrooms have sliding glass doors to the furnished wraparound balcony with lake and Gulf views, making it easy to start each morning in the balmy breeze!With water views and beach access less than 100 feet away, Wine’d Down offers a convenient and luxurious Seagrove Beach escape. Easily explore with parking for 4 vehicles, plus 7 complimentary adult bikes and a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSFIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower only- Guest Bunkroom: Queen-over-Queen Bunk, Shared Bathroom with Shower onlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only
